description.narrative: International Crimincal Court's Trust Fund for Victims aims to improve the conditions for people affected by war crimes and crimes agains humamanity follwoing the Rome statues and ICC mandate.
International Crimincal Court's Trust Fund for Victims arbetar för att förbättra förutsättningarna för människor drabbade av krigsbrott och brott mot mänskligheten enligt Rom-stadgan och ICCs mandat.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: ICC TFV has conducted activities within both their mandates - Assistance and Reparations - during the year. No concrete implementation of court-ordered assistance projects have started yet, but planning and investigations have taken place in relation first and foremost in relation to the Thomas Lubanga case. Within the assistance mandate the TFV has supported implementing partners to provide medical, materiel and psychological rehabilitation in the DRC and medical and psychological rehabilitation in Northern Uganda. The work is considered effective and efficient and the TFV has contributed to strengthen the capacity of and collaboration between the implementing partners - most of them local organisations - through their accompaniement approach. The TFV has also worked in relation to authorities and public health institutions in order to build a response as sustainable as possible to the victims.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
